ModMetaData.name: Dead Man's Switch - Character Editor Support
ModMetaData.author: lzzd
ModMetaData.description:
Lets Character Editor open the mechanoids and synthetics from The Dead Man's Switch and its add-ons.

Character Editor only recognises a selected unit when its type is exactly Pawn. Vanilla mechanoids are, but every DMS unit uses a Pawn subclass, so selecting one and opening the editor showed someone else. This patch makes Character Editor accept DMS units both when opening the editor and in its pawn list, and for DMS mechanoids hides the human-only backstory, traits and favourite-colour sections as well as the skills panel, matching what the editor shows for vanilla mechanoids. Vanilla and other mods' units are not affected.

Requires Harmony, The Dead Man's Switch and Character Editor.

让 Character Editor 能编辑《失能机关》（The Dead Man's Switch）及其拓展的机械体、合成人。

Character Editor 只把类型恰好是 Pawn 的单位认作小人。原版机械体正好是 Pawn，而失能机关的单位全部是 Pawn 的子类，所以选中它们再打开编辑器时显示的是别人。本补丁让 Character Editor 在打开编辑器和同步小人列表时认出失能机关的单位，并且像对待原版机械体那样，不为它们显示经历、特性、喜爱的颜色这些只对人类有意义的板块和技能面板。原版单位和其他模组不受影响。

需要 Harmony、失能机关本体和 Character Editor。
